item: API-error echo dedupe — synthetic assistant + result.is_error (2026-08-24)
branch: an API error the CLI echoes twice (a synthetic assistant message AND the result's is_error text) draws ONE .error block, not an .error plus a prose .blk
provenance: Both frames are CAPTURED wire shapes, taped live 2026-08-24 (CLI 2.1.241) from a real failing turn: set_model haiku[1m] then one user turn -> the CLI emits {type:'assistant', message:{model:'<synthetic>', content:[{type:'text', text:'API Error: 400 ...'}]}} followed by {type:'result', subtype:'success', is_error:true, result:<same text>}. The transcript persists ONLY the assistant record (+ top-level isApiErrorMessage:true), and SessionStore already maps that to an error item ('live draws it as an .error block, so replay must not render it as prose' — SessionStore.kt), so replay was always single; the LIVE panel drew both (user screenshot 2026-08-24: a plain bullet line above the red block). The duplication only occurs on UNSTREAMED error turns — msgStreamed gates the whole-message branch, so a turn that already streamed content never drew the prose copy, which is why this survived unnoticed. Fix: the assistant whole-message branch stashes a synthetic message's text instead of drawing it; the result's is_error errorBlock is then the one copy, and a non-error result drains any stash into an errorBlock so nothing can be swallowed. NEGATIVE CONTROL RUN 2026-08-24 against the pre-fix build (the sandbox launched before the JS edit — resources are spliced at page load, so it still served the old bytes): errsAdded 1 passed but blksAdded read 1 (the prose copy) and FAILED against the expected 0; after the edit and a restart, blksAdded 0 and all green. HARDENED 2026-08-25 (user asked whether dedupe could swallow a message): the stash became an ARRAY drained on every result branch, and dedupe keys on EXACT text equality with the result's is_error text — a differing text, a second synthetic message, an interrupt, or a non-error result all draw their own error blocks. SECOND CONTROL 2026-08-25 against the pre-hardening build (again the free still-running-sandbox control): step 2 FAILED with errsAdded 1 != 2 and hasNotice False != True (the unrepeated synthetic text was silently dropped), hasResult passed in both builds; after the hardening and a restart, 5/5.

steps.note: the captured pair adds exactly one .error block and zero prose .blk
steps.setup: window.__dup = (function () { const errs0 = document.querySelectorAll('#log .error').length; const blks0 = document.querySelectorAll('#log .blk').length; window.onClaudeEvent(JSON.stringify({ type: 'assistant', uuid: 'fx56-a', message: { id: 'fx56-m', model: '<synthetic>', role: 'assistant', type: 'message', stop_reason: 'stop_sequence', content: [ { type: 'text', text: 'API Error: 400 The long context beta is not yet available for this subscription.' } ] } })); window.onClaudeEvent(JSON.stringify({ type: 'result', subtype: 'success', is_error: true, result: 'API Error: 400 The long context beta is not yet available for this subscription.' })); return { errsAdded: document.querySelectorAll('#log .error').length - errs0, blksAdded: document.querySelectorAll('#log .blk').length - blks0 }; })();

expect.why: GUARD: the result's is_error still draws its red error block — the dedupe must not swallow the error itself
DISCRIMINATING: the synthetic assistant echo is NOT drawn as prose (1 pre-fix — the duplicate bullet line in the user's screenshot)

steps.note: a synthetic text the result does NOT repeat is never swallowed — dedupe is by exact text, not by kind
steps.setup: window.__dup2 = (function () { const errs0 = document.querySelectorAll('#log .error').length; window.onClaudeEvent(JSON.stringify({ type: 'assistant', uuid: 'fx56-b', message: { id: 'fx56-m2', model: '<synthetic>', role: 'assistant', type: 'message', content: [ { type: 'text', text: 'Synthetic notice fx56 that the result will not repeat.' } ] } })); window.onClaudeEvent(JSON.stringify({ type: 'result', subtype: 'success', is_error: true, result: 'API Error: 500 something else entirely.' })); const all = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('#log .error')); const texts = all.slice(-2).map(function (e) { return e.textContent; }); return { errsAdded: all.length - errs0, hasNotice: texts.some(function (t) { return t.indexOf('fx56') !== -1; }), hasResult: texts.some(function (t) { return t.indexOf('500 something else') !== -1; }) }; })();

expect.why: DISCRIMINATING: differing texts mean two distinct messages — both drawn as error blocks (1 pre-hardening: the unrepeated synthetic text was silently dropped)
DISCRIMINATING: the synthetic text the result did not repeat is on screen (false pre-hardening)
GUARD: the result's own error text is on screen in both builds
